name: Beijing Electronic Zone High-tech Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Electronic Zone High-tech Group Co., Ltd. engages in real estate development business in China and internationally. The company develops, leases, and sells commercial housing and properties, as well as engages in real estate development and property management businesses. The company offers technology industry services, spatial digitalization services, and technology-driven urban renewal services. Beijing Electronic Zone High-tech Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. The company operates as a subsidiary of Beijing Electronics Holding Co.,Ltd.
